subject: A new star low in the west at dusk over the Barrens flats, brighter than the rest, a faint plume: a drive braking. The colony domes in silhouette, one figure at a long lens on a tripod.
notes: Barrens Part 3. Screenprint light. Barrens' own dun and red ground. Never show the Mocker itself: only what it leaves and who sees it.
